title: Hangzhou Metro Passenger Simulation
summary: Simulate one operating day of Hangzhou metro passenger trips from staged AFC demand, GIS, and network configuration inputs.
taskPrompt:
Produce a one-day Hangzhou metro passenger simulation using the authentic AFC, GIS and network configuration files.

Read base/input/task_prompt.md, base/input/output_contract.json and base/input/simulation_contract.md. Implement the public hangzhou-discrete-event-v2 contract: GIS-derived segment running times, NetworkX 3.6.1 route enumeration, seeded multinomial-logit route choice, scheduled directional trains, FIFO entry and platform queues, transfers and capacity conservation. Do not fit to AFC end times.

Write base/output/passenger_records.csv (all and only completed trips, required nine-column schema), base/output/validation_report.txt (truthful finite duration metrics), and base/output/simulation_manifest.json (contract_version and an unsigned 64-bit seed). The scatter plot is optional.

Different seeds are valid. Evaluation recomputes the public model, not a hidden historical answer table. Do not modify input files.
agentMustDo: Read the staged task prompt, output contract, and simulation_contract.md from `input/`.
Implement the public v2 seeded model with GIS-derived running times, MNL routes, scheduled trains, FIFO entry/platform queues, transfers and capacity constraints.
Write `passenger_records.csv`, `validation_report.txt`, and `simulation_manifest.json` into `output/` with the required schema.
Use the staged runtime manifest only if extra Python dependencies are needed.

inputFiles.name: simulation_contract.md
inputFiles.description: Public v2 geometry, routing, RNG, train scheduling, queueing and conservation rules.

inputFiles.name: afc_hangzhou.csv
inputFiles.description: Visible AFC trip records for one operating day.

inputFiles.name: station_sequence.csv
inputFiles.description: Ordered station sequences by line and direction.

inputFiles.name: operation_parameters.json
inputFiles.description: Simulation and routing parameters for the metro task.

inputFiles.name: runtime_env/
inputFiles.description: Agent-installable dependency manifest for optional Python tooling.

referenceFiles.name: simulation_manifest.json
referenceFiles.description: Required public contract version and solver-selected unsigned 64-bit seed.

referenceFiles.name: validation_report.txt
referenceFiles.description: Required summary-metric report derived from the candidate CSV.

evaluation: Recompute the published stochastic discrete-event model from authentic public inputs and the declared seed. Require all completed trips, exact integer dynamics, demand conservation, truthful observed columns and finite report metrics. Historical passenger tables and label-distance anti-copy thresholds are not used. Different seeds are valid. The unchanged 80% coverage floor is a public-model feasibility check, not permission to omit completed trips.
